Cartography, the study of the physical representation of the Earth's surface, has a rich and fascinating history that spans thousands of years. The earliest known cartographic work dates back to the ancient Greeks, who used a system of symbols and lines to represent the Earth's surface. This system, known as the Ptolemaic system, was based on the geocentric model of the universe, which placed the Earth at the center of the universe and the other planets in orbit around it.
